sources.title: NPS Yellowstone Hydrothermal Features: Travertine Terraces
sources.notes: Calcium carbonate deposited after dissolved CO2 releases; actual travertine photo shows thin scalloped cream shelves with shallow flat pools and irregular linked progression. This is not the geyser/silica image.
